body_lead: Bhubaneswar, Sep 5: The Odisha Higher Education Department on Saturday signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with CSRBOX, Nandi Foundation and Odisha Knowledge Corporation Limited (OKCL) to strengthen skill development, employability and digital learning among students across the state. In collaboration with NASSCOM, the department also launched the ‘AI Course for All’ programme, providing students and faculty members with opportunities to acquire skills in Artificial Intelligence (AI).
